edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the dispute described as [IDENTIFY UNDERLYING DISPUTE] (the “Dispute”) on the terms set out in this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [AMOUNT AND CURRENCY] (the “Settlement Amount”) in cleared funds within [NUMBER] days after execution of this Agreement by both parties. The amount, currency, and payment deadline remain unagreed and subject to client approval.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or to rights or claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; disclosures to their professional advisers who are bound by professional duties of confidentiality or agree to keep those terms confidential; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement.
